children: Overview
Sweden technical solutions provider's Q3 net sales grew 9% yr/yr, organic growth also 9%
Order backlog reached record SEK 24,216 mln, up 48% yr/yr
Company completed Åslunds El acquisition during the quarter
Outlook
Bravida expects to convert its record order backlog into continued growth and improve profitability
Company says demand remains strong for data centres, infrastructure and defence projects, but new construction in Norway and southern Sweden is weak
Bravida sees attractive long-term opportunities from digitalisation, electrification and increased infrastructure investment
Result Drivers
ORDER INTAKE AND BACKLOG - Co said increased activity led to a 72% rise in order intake and record-high order backlog, positioning it for continued growth
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Co said improved profitability in all markets was driven by higher volumes, transformation in Denmark, and focus on project implementation and operational efficiency
